title: fix(react,core): stop spreading an authored `data` as a prop on object-arm blocks (objectui#9571)
body:
Fixes #9571

Executes objectui#8348 Q2-C — decision batch #136 item 3, maintainer 「同意」 on the seat's recommendation. Not a decision; execution.

## What was wrong

「8348 以协议为准」 (batch #83) retired the bare-array `data` shorthand at the shared record-source ladder. The authored key had a SECOND carrier the ruling did not reach, and it is the one that wins: `SchemaRenderer` spreads every non-metadata node key as a React prop, and `ObjectGrid` (`passedData`), `ObjectMap` (`dataProp`) and `ObjectGantt` each lift a `data` PROP with an unconditional `Array.isArray` at higher priority than the ladder. An authored `data: [ ...rows... ]` therefore still drew end-to-end. AGENTS.md #0.1: one key, one honoured spelling — the tolerated second carrier is the defect.

## What this does

`SchemaRenderer` no longer spreads an authored `data` key for a block whose published `data` row is the `ViewData` OBJECT arm. The key reaches such a block only as `schema.data`, judged by the row. One new reading in `@object-ui/core` answers the arm — `recordSourceDataArmForType(type)` — for the one consumer that cannot be handed the arm as a parameter, a renderer generic over every registered type.

⛔ The `data` PROP is untouched. Option B (gating the prop on the arm) was refused: that prop is how a host such as `plugin-list`'s `ListView` hands down rows it already fetched. `...props` is spread LAST in `SchemaRenderer`, so a host still delivers its rows and still outranks the authored key; a host that renders the block component directly never passes through here at all. Both legs are pinned.

Array-arm blocks are untouched by kind: `object-calendar`'s published row is `z.array(...)`, so its bare array is on-contract and keeps the prop seat. Every type the reading does not list keeps today's behaviour verbatim — the default is the no-change direction, so the table's mere existence re-decides nothing.

## Three PM mechanism assumptions, measured

**(a) The card's title mislocates the file — CONFIRMED, with one refinement.** The symbol is `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`, so the package is `@object-ui/react`. `git grep -nw` finds THREE definition-shaped hits, not two: the real one, the `packages/vscode-extension` test fixture the PM named, and a third in `scripts/__tests__/check-component-surface-parity.test.ts` (a fixture string). Neither extra is the renderer.

**(b) The "two blocks" census is WRONG — there are THREE.** `ObjectGantt` does exactly what the card describes: it passes `'view-data'` to the shared ladder, and its `reload` opens with a `data`-prop check (`(rest as any).data && Array.isArray(...)`, step "1. Check for data prop (Unified ListView)"), plus a sibling `hasHostData` read. So it is an object-arm block whose prop carrier outranks the ladder.

⚠️ This PR covers it, and that is the ruling's own scope rather than a widening. Ruling C is stated over the ARM, not over a block list: excluding gantt would require either a two-name allowlist — the second de-facto contract AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids — or a false row in the arm table. ⛔ No gantt source file is touched, and gantt's own `data`-prop reader is not changed. Flagged for the seat: if the ruling was meant to be block-scoped rather than arm-scoped, that is a one-line change to the arm table and a re-read of this paragraph.

`ObjectTree` and `ObjectKanban` also lift a `data` prop with `Array.isArray`, and are correctly outside the ruling: tree's arm is `'undeclared'` (no published face declares a `data` row) and kanban's published row is the array arm and walks no shared ladder at all.

**(c) The array-arm boundary — CONFIRMED at the boundary, and the change does not depend on it.** `plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx`'s `resolveExternalData` is `Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : undefined`, and nothing is spread from `rest`. But the stronger fact is that the strip is keyed on the arm: `object-calendar` is the `'array'` arm, so it is not stripped at all. Pinned as a control in the new `packages/react` file rather than in `plugin-calendar`, which is outside this card's file surface.

## ⚠️ A card premise that is FALSE: "the retired-spelling signal the ladder emits"

The acceptance asks that the signal the ladder already emits be what the author sees. Measured: **the ladder emits nothing.** `resolveRecordSourceConfig` returns `null` and falls through silently; `validateSchema` — the `__DEV__` pass in `SchemaRenderer` — never reads `data` against a block's row; no `console.warn` exists anywhere on that path. The refusal is loud at authoring time (`os validate`, the save gate, the zod row) and mute at render time.

Without a signal this ruling lands as a page whose rows were on screen yesterday and are gone today, with nothing naming the dropped key — the "author gets a success receipt" shape AGENTS.md #0.1 and `ObjectGrid`'s own column diagnostic exist to prevent. So the strip site emits one `__DEV__` warn-once naming the key, the arm and the spelling that works. It lives inside `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, inside the declared file surface, and is read-only.

## ⭐ A trap the registry-derived pin caught on its first run

One `ComponentRegistry.register()` call produces SEVERAL keys, and `SchemaRenderer` looks the arm up with the raw `schema.type`. The first draft of the arm table carried a row for bare `grid` — which is **not** a grid key: `plugin-grid` registers its `view` alias with `skipFallback: true` precisely so the bare key stays with `@object-ui/components`' LAYOUT grid container. That row would have stripped `data` from a block that declares no `data` row at all. The table's rows are now the measured registry keys (`object-grid`, `plugin-grid:object-grid`, `view:grid`; `object-map`, `plugin-map:object-map`, `view:map`, `map`; `object-gantt`, `plugin-gantt:object-gantt`), and the pins read them back off `ComponentRegistry.getAllTypes()` grouped by resolved renderer — so a new alias without a row goes red instead of quietly answering `'undeclared'`. A control pins that bare `grid` is a different renderer and answers `'undeclared'`.

## Pins, and that they can go red

New: `packages/react/src/__tests__/SchemaRenderer.dataPropArm-9571.test.tsx` (23 tests) — per-key refusal on the object arm, the key still reaching `schema.data`, array-arm and undeclared-arm controls, the two host-path legs, a byte-identical-bag leg, the dev warning firing and not firing, and the bare-`grid` control.

Updated: `gridBareArrayDataRefused-8348.test.tsx` row 3 and `ObjectMap.schemaDataShorthand.test.tsx` row 3 — both previously asserted "through `SchemaRenderer` the array still draws, from the PROPS channel", which is exactly the sentence this card retires. Both files' docblocks are rewritten to say what is true now rather than left describing the old tree.

The card asks that the new pins be shown able to go red, honouring `ObjectCalendar.recordSourceMembers-8314.test.tsx`'s warning about a pin that cannot fail. The ablation (mutate, prove the mutation reached disk, run, restore, prove the restore) is recorded in the report on objectui#9571.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope, noted and not filed:

- `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`'s `gridNeedsDataSource` still carries `if (Array.isArray(schema?.data)) return false;` — an escape hatch meaning "this placement can draw without an adapter". objectui#8348 already made its stated reason false at the ladder; this PR makes it false at the remaining carrier too. Consequence: a grid authored with a bare `data` array, an `objectName` and NO adapter now draws nothing while the "no data source" gate stays silent. The new `__DEV__` warning names the dropped key, so the author is no longer told nothing at all. That file is source, not a pin, and is outside this card's declared file surface — reported for the seat rather than repaired here. Dedupe words: `gridNeedsDataSource`, `requiresDataSource`, bare array escape hatch, ElementDataSourceGate, objectui#5378 item 2.
- `ObjectGantt`, `ObjectMap` and `ObjectGrid` each still read the `data` prop through an `as any` / untyped `rest` bag, so nothing type-checks the one prop this card just made single-purpose. Observation, not a defect. Noted, not filed. Successor: whoever next types those props bags.

## 本轮改动的中文速读

改了什么:`SchemaRenderer` 不再把作者写的 `data` 键当 React prop 铺给「object 臂」的区块(grid / map / gantt),该键只以 `schema.data` 到达,由区块自己发布的行裁决。宿主传的 `data` prop 一字未动。

为什么改:8348 的裁决在阶梯上落了地,却漏了优先级更高的第二条载体,于是裁决对作者不可见 —— 写裸数组照样出数据。

风险与回滚:风险面是「object 臂」的三个区块;数组臂(日历)按类不受影响。回滚 = 还原 `SchemaRenderer.tsx` 里那一段 strip 与 `@object-ui/core` 的新读数,两处都是加法。
